quality_limits: Reference portraits and targets can be different photographs; side-by-side layout is not a same-image before/after.
Current applied labels or selected thumbnails do not establish an observed import/application sequence or completed quality.
Visible zero sliders do not prove no AI color transformation exists.
Frame09 changes costume/background color too; this does not establish protection of role-specific colors.
Video previews do not establish identity, joint continuity or original/exported image quality.
Promotional speed statements are not measured local task timings.
